title: I made more money the year I started trading less. Still feels backwards to say.
author: Electronic_Tea_2948
selftext:
I used to think more trades meant more money. So I traded every single day, sometimes ten times, because sitting idle felt like losing.

Then one month I got busy with life and barely traded. Nifty was just chopping between roughly 24,100 and 24,400 that whole stretch, going nowhere, and normally I would have overtraded that range to death and bled on brokerage. Instead I took maybe four trades. It was one of my best months.

That broke my brain a little. When I looked back, almost every loss I ever took came from forcing a trade in a flat, going-nowhere market just to feel busy. On days Nifty moved 40 points in a tight range, I had no business being in five trades, but I was.

Now I treat not trading as a skill. A sideways day where I did nothing feels like a win.

Anyone else make more by doing less? Still messes with my head.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: yeah, a range like 24,100 to 24,400 punishes activity more than anything else. sitting out was the trade that month.
